label: Fortis Advisors v. Johnson & Johnson (Auris Health) — ten milestones, none of them a number
provenance: PUBLIC RECORD. Fortis Advisors LLC v. Johnson & Johnson / Ethicon (Del. Ch.; trial Jan 2024, liability Sep 2024, stipulated judgment of approximately $811 million on Jan 26, 2026; aff'd in part, Johnson & Johnson v. Fortis Advisors LLC, No. 490,2024 (Del. 2026)). Reported structure: $3.4 billion paid at closing plus up to $2.35 billion in earnout contingent on two commercial and eight regulatory milestones, none of which was paid; one named milestone was $100 million on FDA 510(k) clearance for Monarch lung tissue ablation.
simplifications: Only the named $100 million milestone is expressed here. The other nine are not individually quantified in the summaries used.

deal.metricName: FDA 510(k) clearance for Monarch lung tissue ablation

terms.eventDescription: regulatory clearance, and nine further commercial and regulatory milestones

settled.note: No earnout was paid. The approximately $811 million judgment is damages for breach and fraud, not an earnout payment, and is not what this harness asserts.
